description: This Java source file defines the `GaugesPanel` class, which is part of a graphical user interface for displaying gauges and related controls in a car tuning or diagnostic application. It manages the layout of gauges, message panels, and controls for showing/hiding RPM and messages, saving images, and adjusting the grid size for gauges. It also includes UI components for configuration and interaction.

classes.name: GaugesPanel
classes.description: Main GUI component managing gauges, messages, and controls for a car diagnostics application.

methods.name: GaugesPanel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the gauges panel, setting up layout, and loading configuration.

methods.name: createMiddleLeftPanel
methods.description: Creates the main gauges display panel with gauges grid and RPM panel.

methods.name: createTopPanel
methods.description: Creates the top control panel consisting of buttons and configuration menus.

methods.name: createRightTopPanel
methods.description: Creates the right-side top panel with size selector and menu button.

methods.name: createMenu
methods.description: Builds a context menu to toggle RPM display, show messages, save logs, etc.

methods.name: prepareMessagesPanel
methods.description: Initializes the messages panel UI components.

methods.name: createLeftTopPanel
methods.description: Creates the top-left panel with pause, save image buttons, and RPM label.

methods.name: createPauseButton
methods.description: Creates a pause/resume button for data updates.

methods.name: createSaveImageButton
methods.description: Creates a button to save current gauge display as an image.

methods.name: setSensorGridDimensions
methods.description: Configures the gauge grid with specified number of rows and columns.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves the gauge grid size configuration.

methods.name: applyShowFlags
methods.description: Shows or hides RPM and message panels based on flags.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the main GUI component for embedding.
